label: EasyBroker
description: Manage real estate properties, contacts and lead requests; watch for new leads and updates.

operations.name: list_collaborations
operations.description: Returns a list of collaborations from your organization.

operations.name: list_contact_requests
operations.description: Returns a list of the contact requests in a given period or for a specific property, if no parameters are provided all the contact requests will be returned

operations.name: create_contact_request
operations.description: Creates or updates a new lead in EasyBroker that is interested in the provided property.

operations.name: list_contacts
operations.description: Returns a list of contacts from your organization.

operations.name: get_contact
operations.description: Returns the detailed information of a contact from your EasyBroker account.

operations.name: update_contact
operations.description: Updates an existing contact in your EasyBroker account. Only the fields you send are modified. For `emails`, `phones`, `addresses` and `tags`, the value you send fully replaces the current list — matching entries are preserved, missing entries are removed and new entries are appended (order is ignored).

operations.name: list_features
operations.description:
Returns a list of the property features available in your organization's country.
                         You can also provide a `locale` parameter to define the language you want the name of the features to be in.

operations.name: list_listing_statuses
operations.description: Returns a list of property listing statuses from your organization.

operations.name: get_locations
operations.description: Retrieve a location name and the children of a given location <neighborhood, city, state>. If no parameter provided, the states from the country registered in your account will be returned. Send `postal_code` instead of `query` to retrieve the city a postal code belongs to together with its neighborhoods mapped to that postal code.

operations.name: list_properties
operations.description: Returns a list of properties from your organization.

operations.name: create_property
operations.description: Creates a new property in your EasyBroker account, which will be published to all your connected apps.

operations.name: get_property
operations.description: Returns the detailed information of a property from your EasyBroker account.

operations.name: update_property
operations.description: Updates an existing property in your EasyBroker account.

operations.name: list_property_integrations
operations.description: Returns, for every property in your organization connected to at least one portal, its publication status across all connected portals. Results are paginated by property, so `limit` counts properties rather than portal listings.

operations.name: list_property_types
operations.description:
Returns a list of the property types from your organization's country.
                         You can also provide a `locale` parameter to define the language you want the name of the property types to be in.

operations.name: list_users
operations.description: Returns a list of active users from your organization.
